posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Chaosmancer:

I'm saying Omega's could appear anywhere, those particles move fast enough to reach space in seconds so they can hit various parts of the Earth theoritically.

Not necessarily.  Space isn't that far away.  But they said that the exotic mesons lasted "a few seconds" (quote from the wiki cliffnotes), and travel at relativistic speeds.  1 second at 1/20th speed of light is long enough to pass through the diameter of the Earth.  All that said, the Nolan Generator isn't the only source of mesons out there - it's only most productive one.  Anything from a random science experiment to a crash-landed spaceship with a matter/antimatter drive could produce Isoflux Alpha - but it's going to produce a lot less than the Nolan Generator does.

 

Incidentally, the fact that you can plug "speed of light * 1s / diameter of the earth" into Google and get back an answer that takes care of all the conversions for you is way cool.

No time to relisten to get exact quote/timecode, but here's my notes from the Gen Con Q&A:

  • Was the OblivAeon event just an excuse for a gritty reboot or are there even Tactics comics? Are there other timelines' comics? There are a lot of timelines after OblivAeon, but there's only a few with comics told (the ones we know about). What we call the RPG timeline was the immediate post-OblivAeon relaunch of the comics setting as they rebranded things and tried to make things a good jumping-on point for new readers. Some books maintain numbering across the post-Multiverse relaunch, but Freedom Five ends with The Sentinels of Freedom as a new title that takes its place. Tactics was another relaunch years later as a response to the overly-positive RPG setting that a bunch of young-gun writers do who started with the premise of "what if things went even worse during OblivAeon?" and then ran with it.

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked: In he real-world timeline of game release, Tactics definitely came first. But in terms of the comics publishing universe, the RPG came first and then a few years later, the Tactics line was released. Tactics starts several years after the OblivAeon event, whereas the RPG begins almost immediately, so that at least lines up.
